scenes.headline: How reusing layers buys reasoning, not knowledge
scenes.sub: Virtual logic depth: running tied transformer blocks more than once.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Echo! What happens when a transformer runs the same layers more than once? It reasons better, but it doesn't know more. Here's how.

scenes.text: Reuse tied transformer blocks to add depth without adding parameters. Knowledge capacity stays nearly flat, while reasoning climbs.
scenes.say: The idea is virtual logic depth: run the same blocks again, with the same weights. The model gets deeper without getting any bigger.

scenes.title: One set of weights, run again

steps.say: A plain transformer sends each token through its blocks once, and every block has its own weights.

steps.note: tied weights: effective depth grows, parameters don't
steps.say: Here the blocks run again, with tied weights. Effective depth grows with every pass, and the parameter count doesn't move.

scenes.title: Three ways to reuse a layer

items.text: Sequence: B1 B1 B2 B2 B3 B3
items.say: Sequence repeats each block in place before moving on.

items.text: Cycle: B1 B2 B3 B1 B2 B3
Inverse: B1 B2 B3 B3 B2 B1
items.say: Inverse cycle runs every second pass backwards. On the paper's math problems, cycle wins almost everywhere.

scenes.title: Knowledge, counted in bits
scenes.say: To measure knowledge, a small GPT-2 memorizes a long run of random tokens.

parts.note: entropy of the random sequence, fixed by construction
parts.say: H one is the entropy of that sequence, fixed by construction.

parts.note: entropy the trained model still can't collapse
parts.say: H two is what the trained model still can't pin down.

parts.note: bits absorbed: loop more, and it barely moves
parts.say: The difference is the bits it absorbed. Loop the same model more times, and that number barely moves.

scenes.title: iGSM reasoning accuracy
scenes.say: Reasoning is measured on synthetic math that can't be memorized. Looped, a fifty-million-parameter model beats a native model three times its size.

scenes.text: Looping adds computation over the storage a model already has: more reasoning per parameter, not more knowledge, and not free compute.
scenes.say: So looping adds computation, not storage. More reasoning per parameter, but not more knowledge, and every extra pass is another forward pass.

recap: Tied blocks run again: deeper, not bigger
Absorbed bits stay flat as the loop grows
Reasoning climbs, paid for in compute
scenes.say: To recap: tied blocks run again, knowledge stays flat, and reasoning climbs, paid for in compute.
